# sendio_domain (Data Source)

Looks up one domain by id or name, with its DNS records.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sendio_domain" "mail" {
  name = "mail.example.com"
}

output "mail_domain_status" {
  value = data.sendio_domain.mail.status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Domain id. Set `id` or `name`.
- `name` (String) Domain name. Set `id` or `name`.

### Read-Only

- `click_tracking` (Boolean) Whether clicks are tracked.
- `created_at` (String) When the domain was added.
- `custom_return_path` (String) Return-Path subdomain label.
- `open_tracking` (Boolean) Whether opens are tracked.
- `records` (Attributes List) DNS records to publish. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records))
- `region` (String) Sending region.
- `status` (String) Verification status.
- `tracking_status` (String) Status of the tracking host.
- `tracking_subdomain` (String) Subdomain label for tracked links.

<a id="nestedatt--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Record name.
- `priority` (Number) MX priority.
- `record` (String) What the record is for.
- `status` (String) Verification status of this record.
- `ttl` (String) Suggested TTL.
- `type` (String) DNS record type.
- `value` (String) Record value.
